text.name: function_spsSprayerSilo
text.text: Four separate liquid tanks behind one SPS pipe connection. Walk into the switch box to choose the tank; any liquid fertiliser or herbicide, each tank locks to what it holds until empty. Pipe-only: no drive-under loading.

text.name: sps_settingsIbcPersistTooltip
text.text: Yes: emptied IBCs stay on the map (return to store or refill them). No: they disappear when emptied (default).

text.name: sps_settingsPhysicalPipesTooltip
text.text: No: original system - lay and connect pipes at the couplings, chains, sprayer and water/milk lanes; the bought pipes are hidden in the shop. Yes: physical pipes only - buy pipes in the shop, carry them with your hands; every original pipe prompt is switched off. The two systems never run together.

text.name: sps_pipeModeTitle
text.text: Slurry Pipe System - choose your pipe system

text.name: sps_pipeModeQuestion
text.text:
Which pipe system do you want to use in this game?
ORIGINAL: lay and connect pipes at the couplings, chains, sprayers and water/milk lanes as before. PHYSICAL (new): buy pipes in the shop, carry them with your hands; the original lay/connect system is switched off.
The two never run together. You can change this later under Settings > Physical Pipes.

text.name: function_spsCowBarnMedium
text.text: The medium Rudolf Hörmann cow barn with three pipe connections: slurry out, milk out and drinking water in. The water is a real 35,000 l supply here, so the cows must be watered by pipe or trailer.

text.name: function_spsHose
text.text: A physical pipe. Choose it in the shop: slurry 140 mm, water or milk 80 mm, 4 m or 6 m, and for slurry the ends (female/male, female/female or male/male). Pick it up with your hands (left mouse), carry an end to a coupling and press the right mouse button to connect it. Right mouse at a connected end unplugs it into your hands; left mouse on a connected pipe drops it. Slurry pipes take a colour. Fixed after purchase - sell it to change.

text.name: function_spsDockingStation
text.text: A portable docking post. Carry it with your hands (left mouse) and set it down where you need it, plug a pipe into its coupling, then dock a tanker's fill arm into the rubber boot to load through the pipe.

text.name: function_spsWaterCourseDraw
text.text: Draw a ring around a lake or river so SPS tankers can draw water from it. Click the water first (sets the level), then click markers around the shore, click the first marker to close.

text.name: function_spsWaterCourseRemove
text.text: Remove a water course you drew earlier.

text.name: sps_waterCourse_hintClickWater
text.text: Click on the water first - that sets the water level

text.name: sps_waterCourse_clickWaterFirst
text.text: No water here - click on the water first

text.name: sps_waterCourse_levelSet
text.text: Water level set - now click markers around the shore

text.name: sps_waterCourse_noneOnMap
text.text: No drawn water courses on this map

text.name: sps_waterCourse_edgeTooShort
text.text: Too close to the last marker

text.name: sps_waterCourse_crossing
text.text: The line would cross the ring

text.name: function_spsTowerMixer
text.text: A tractor-driven lagoon mixer on a folding tower. Lower the legs, fold the boom into the store and mix the slurry with the PTO; a pipe from its pump moves the mixed slurry to a tanker.
